phase1_gate.required_checkpoint: A later disabled, expiring source inspection must return selection_trusted=true while source.enabled=false and prepare_eligible=false.

hard_stops: Do not run ownership_inspect_bind_source during groundwork.
Do not call any Bind source create/enable or Bind prepare/confirm/reconcile function against Devnet.
Do not mint, sign, submit, deploy, upgrade, or change Solana configuration, collections, or secrets.
Do not enable a player-facing Bind gate or allowlist.
Do not edit Unity, mobile, or APK artifacts.
Do not record fabricated observations or secret values.

cases.title: Happy-path archive creation with Stamped move
required_disposable_inputs: trusted disabled-source checkpoint followed by separately approved enablement
unused idempotency key and archive/receipt PDAs
cases.expected_terminal_state: One finalized archive and completed receipt; both inputs burned; Chainling bound; source consumed; operation and 250 RAM debit settled exactly once.

cases.title: Happy-path archive creation with Cosmetic
required_disposable_inputs: trusted disabled-source checkpoint followed by separately approved enablement
unused idempotency key and archive/receipt PDAs
cases.expected_terminal_state: One finalized archive and completed receipt; both inputs burned; Chainling bound; source consumed; operation and 250 RAM debit settled exactly once.

cases.title: Wrong asset owner
required_disposable_inputs: one input owned by a second disposable wallet
cases.expected_terminal_state: Owner mismatch rejection with no receipt, archive, burn, Chainling mutation, settlement, or RAM debit.
evidence_fields: zero-delta asset account and ledger hashes

cases.title: Wrong Core update authority
required_disposable_inputs: subcase supplying a non-PDA Core-authority account
subcase using a collection fixture with update authority other than the program Core-authority PDA
cases.expected_terminal_state: Core-authority seed constraint, trust, or InvalidCollectionAuthority rejection with no on-chain or database settlement.
evidence_fields: constraint error InvalidCollectionAuthority or inspection reason

cases.title: Wrong collection
required_disposable_inputs: wallet-owned disposable input assigned to a non-configured collection
cases.expected_terminal_state: WrongCollection or trust rejection with no state mutation.
evidence_fields: source operation and zero-delta account evidence

cases.title: Invalid component kind
cases.expected_terminal_state: InvalidComponentKind with no receipt, archive, burn, binding, or RAM debit.
evidence_fields: simulation or transaction error and logs

cases.title: Cover and component reuse
required_disposable_inputs: subcase supplying one disposable Core asset as both Cover and component
subcase retrying an input consumed by a prior successful fixture
cases.expected_terminal_state: DuplicateComponent or unavailable/reused-input rejection; no additional asset consumption, binding, settlement, or RAM debit.
evidence_fields: asset existence hashes and aggregate counts before and after

cases.title: Low RAM
required_disposable_inputs: profile RAM below configured bind cost
cases.expected_terminal_state: Insufficient RAM rejection; no receipt, archive, burn, binding, reservation settlement, or debit.
evidence_fields: pre and post on-chain and Postgres balances

cases.title: Expired RAM reservation
required_disposable_inputs: exact reservation allowed to expire before simulation or submission
cases.expected_terminal_state: ReservationExpired; operation released or failed once; RAM and assets unchanged.

cases.title: Replayed consumed RAM reservation
required_disposable_inputs: fresh unused bind inputs for the replay attempt
cases.expected_terminal_state: ReservationAlreadyConsumed; exactly one original receipt, binding, and debit; no replay mutation.

cases.title: Mismatched RAM reservation
required_disposable_inputs: one controlled mismatch per subcase: operation hash, amount, or reservation kind
cases.expected_terminal_state: IdempotencyMismatch, ReservationAmountMismatch, or InvalidReservationKind with no state mutation.
evidence_fields: expected and observed hash amount kind

cases.title: Already-bound Chainling
required_disposable_inputs: disposable Chainling already bound by a completed fixture
cases.expected_terminal_state: bind_already_exists or AlreadyBound; original archive remains; new inputs and RAM remain untouched.

cases.title: Replayed idempotency key
required_disposable_inputs: conflict subcase with changed source or wallet
cases.expected_terminal_state: Identical replay returns the same operation/result; conflict is rejected; no second reservation, signature, binding, or debit.

cases.title: Second Core burn failure with atomic rollback
required_disposable_inputs: reviewed disposable second input that deterministically fails Core burn after the first burn CPI would execute
cases.expected_terminal_state: Failed transaction atomically restores both assets, reservation, RAM, Chainling, and receipt state; recovery releases the operation once.
evidence_fields: receipt Chainling reservation and profile hashes

cases.title: Archive CreateV2 failure with atomic rollback
required_disposable_inputs: separately reviewed condition that reaches CreateV2 and fails without changing canonical configuration or collections
cases.expected_terminal_state: Failed transaction atomically restores both would-be burns and all program writes; no archive, receipt, binding, or debit.
evidence_fields: proof both burns and CreateV2 were reached
all Core and program account hashes

cases.title: Receipt archive Chainling and RAM invariant verification
cases.expected_terminal_state: Read projection agrees with finalized chain state and proves exactly one binding and one 250 RAM debit.
evidence_fields: archive metadata collection owner and authorities
source operation binding and RAM reconciliation

cases.title: Current archive CreateV2 authority behavior
cases.expected_terminal_state: Record actual deployed behavior; pass only if archive owner is wallet and update authority is program Core-authority PDA, otherwise preserve the exact failure as a finding.
evidence_fields: archive owner update and plugin authorities

cases.title: Retry and reconcile after client timeout
required_disposable_inputs: controlled response drop after submission without transaction resubmission
cases.expected_terminal_state: One eventual settled result or one released failure with no duplicate transaction, binding, source consumption, or debit.

cases.title: Retry and reconcile across finality delay
required_disposable_inputs: controlled observation before and after finality
cases.expected_terminal_state: Pending without premature settlement, then exactly one settlement after a finalized verified receipt or one release after definitive failure or expiry.

cases.title: Retry and reconcile after server restart
required_disposable_inputs: controlled Edge or server restart with durable database state
cases.expected_terminal_state: Reconciliation discovers chain truth and reaches one terminal state without process-memory dependence or double settlement.
